nextGame.note: Monday night game in the Superdome, 20 years after it reopened.

news.headline: Saints add two players for Monday night
news.summary: The Saints moved edge rusher Fadil Diggs and linebacker Jackson Sirmon up from the practice squad for the Atlanta game, so both can play tonight. The Saints have been thin at linebacker all week with Kaden Elliss and Anfernee Jennings hurt.

news.headline: Irma Thomas will sing before Monday night's game
news.summary: Irma Thomas will sing the national anthem in the Superdome, and ESPN will open its broadcast with Anthony Mackie telling the story of the 2006 game. Steve Gleason and Drew Brees will both appear, 20 years after the Superdome reopened.

news.headline: Three Saints defenders are out Monday night
news.summary: Kaden Elliss, Carl Granderson and Anfernee Jennings will all miss the Atlanta game with calf, ankle and knee injuries. Pete Werner and tight end Noah Fant might play.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff. It is homecoming at Florida.

news.headline: Sumrall says the Gators will regroup
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall told reporters Monday that he hates losing more than he likes winning, and that the team has to recalibrate and keep moving forward. Running back Jadan Baugh got only 13 yards on 12 carries at Missouri.

news.headline: Florida falls to No. 16 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Gators dropped eight spots in the Associated Press poll on Sunday after losing at Missouri. Missouri is now ranked 14th, two spots ahead of Florida.

news.headline: Jon Sumrall says the loss starts with him
news.summary: The Florida coach called Saturday's game embarrassing in every part and said the blame starts with the coaching and with him. He also said his team still has growing up to do.

news.headline: LSU's homecoming game will be on ABC or ESPN
news.summary: LSU hosts Mississippi State on Saturday, October 17 at 11 in the morning for homecoming. The league will pick between ABC and ESPN after this weekend's games.

news.headline: LSU moves back into the top 10
news.summary: The Tigers are No. 10 in the Associated Press poll released Sunday, one spot higher after beating McNeese 63-14. LSU plays at Kentucky on Saturday.

news.headline: LSU beats McNeese 63-14
news.summary: LSU gained 731 yards Saturday night in Tiger Stadium and five different players ran for a touchdown. Harlem Berry had 125 yards on the ground, the first 100-yard game of his career.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning kickoff at West Point.

news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.

nextGame.note: Friday kickoff is 3:30 in the afternoon, earlier than usual.

news.headline: Brother Martin pitcher Chance Pecoraro picks Tulane
news.summary: Pecoraro, a junior pitcher at Brother Martin, said he will play baseball at Tulane. He was 3-0 with a 1.90 earned run average last spring and now throws 90 to 92 miles an hour.

news.headline: Brother Martin slips to seventh in the state
news.summary: Crescent City Sports now has the 4-1 Crusaders seventh among Louisiana's Class 5A teams, down from fifth, after Friday's loss to Edna Karr. Karr is 5-0 and first.

news.headline: Edna Karr beats Brother Martin 25-21
news.summary: Karr won Friday night in Hammond after Ty Williams caught two passes on defense in the fourth quarter, one of them run back for a touchdown. Brother Martin is now 4-1.
